turbo_Entity.severityBreakdown.CRITICAL.justification: Both fields refer to the count of critical severity vulnerabilities.

turbo_Entity.severityBreakdown.MAJOR.justification: High severity vulnerabilities are often categorized similarly to major severity, making them conceptually related.

turbo_Entity.severityBreakdown.MINOR.justification: Low severity vulnerabilities are often categorized similarly to minor severity, making them conceptually related.

turbo_Entity.severityBreakdown.NORMAL.justification: Medium severity vulnerabilities can be considered similar to normal severity in some contexts, making them conceptually related.
